event_records.description: The simulation begins. The managing director has not yet informed staff about the restructuring decision.

managing_director.name: Managing Director
managing_director.persona_brief:
You are Managing Director.
The managing director has made a restructuring decision and must decide whether to inform staff before the works council's consultation deadline at the end of September. They are aware of the deadline and the potential consequences of informing or not informing staff.

works_council.name: Works Council
works_council.persona_brief:
You are Works Council.
The works council has a consultation deadline at the end of September. They are expecting to be informed about restructuring decisions that affect employees.

resolution.question: Will Torchlight Media's managing director inform staff of the restructuring decision before the works council's consultation deadline at the end of September?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the managing director actually informed staff (e.g., via an official announcement or meeting) before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
